title: Implement deterministic property checks for verification invariants
objective: Implement a deterministic invariant runner and perturbation generator that can execute verification properties on the existing 60-case regression corpus and on every captured Phase 4 session. The runner must use fixed seeds and reproducible minimal counterexamples, must not depend on a third-party property-testing framework, and must fail closed on any violated invariant. The checks provide assurance without ground-truth labels and integrate into Task 4.0.A's VerificationReport.
required_invariants: Determinism: identical input and seed produce byte-identical output.
Normalization idempotence: normalizing an already normalized artifact produces identical bytes.

Monotonicity under evidence addition: adding events or signals cannot move a satisfied obligation to open unless an explicit regression signal is present; the invariant must document the precise comparison scope and allowed transitions.

Fail-closed under evidence removal: removing supporting signals cannot produce a stronger claim; it must preserve or move the result toward insufficient-evidence unless the remaining explicit evidence independently supports the result.
Command coherence: evaluate output and the internally recomputed evaluation in assess and compare agree for identical trace and ledger inputs.
Metamorphic invariance: identifier renaming and permitted evidence-text variation do not change the semantic verdict.
Every violation emits a typed invariant result with invariant id, seed, command/input identity, minimal reproducer, and safe diagnostic message.
deliverables: Deterministic perturbation generator with fixed seed and reproducible ordering
Fixtures and minimal counterexamples for passing and failing properties
Tests covering all required invariants across the 60-case regression corpus and representative real-session artifacts
Self-check evidence including seeds, perturbation counts, invariant results, and unresolved boundary cases
non_goals: No human or model ground truth
No modification of thresholds to fit existing labels
No changes to existing normative semantics without a separate Class C gate
No persistence, network, database, UI, or automatic interruption
stop_conditions: An invariant is underspecified enough that its implementation would change normative semantics by guesswork
The perturbation generator is not reproducible from recorded seed and input
A violation has no minimal reproducer or safe diagnostic
Evidence removal produces a stronger claim without an explicit remaining basis
The allowed path set is exceeded
Two bounded repair attempts are exhausted
